episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: The discovery of a body believed to be her brother leads Zoe Walker to Ibiza, where she reconnects with his old friend Marcus, a DJ and drug dealer.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: After Axel's memorial service, a frustrated Zoe makes a bold move to force Marcus to come clean. Kika returns home when Andreu suffers a loss.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: Zoe and Boxer run into trouble with the police, but their actions spark even bigger problems for Marcus. Oriol pushes hard for closure on Axel's murder.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: Tensions between the Calafat and Martínez families reignite in the wake of Oriol's ambush on Cristóbal. Zoe gets a surprise visitor in Ibiza.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.summary: Hurtful revelations and a brutal injury create fractures within the Calafat family. Zoe's emotional state drives her to make some impulsive decisions.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.summary: Zoe learns about Axel's darker side, then helps Marcus with a messy situation. At a contentious board meeting, Andreu makes a big announcement.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.summary: The strain on Zoe's marriage intensifies. When David hosts a reunion dinner with the crew, old tensions boil over, pushing Marcus to the brink.

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.summary: Oriol's attempts to forge better communication within his family yield more honesty than expected. Zoe embarks on another frantic search.

episodes.title: Episode 9
episodes.summary: Zoe's trial date arrives. David hits a snag in his efforts to help Oriol with psychedelics. Clint's investigative tactics cross a line.

episodes.title: Episode 10
episodes.summary: On Anna's wedding day, Marcus's actions come back to haunt him. After suffering yet another loss, Zoe vows to finally figure out who killed Axel.
